examples.chinese: 我每個星期都有中文課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí dōu yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
examples.english: I have Chinese class every week.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.english: My father drinks a cup of coffee every morning.

examples.chinese: 我每個週末去學校打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò qù xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I go to school to play basketball every weekend.

examples.chinese: 我每個星期都去學校跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí dōu qù xuéxiào pǎobù.
examples.english: I go to school to run every week.

examples.chinese: 王老師的課很有趣，每個學生都喜歡她。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī de kè hěn yǒuqù, měi ge xuéshēng dōu xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: Teacher Wang’s class is very interesting; every student likes her.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
examples.english: Chinese use different animals to represent each year, and there are a total of twelve kinds of animals.

items.wordHook: a 𠂉(lying person) rests atop 母(mother) → every one: 每(each).

examples.chinese: 很好看。這條藍的也很漂亮，藍色是今年很流行的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn. Zhè tiáo lán de yě hěn piàoliang, lánsè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
examples.english: It is. This pair of blue pants is beautiful too. Blue is a popular color of this year.

items.wordHook: 藍(blue) + 色(color) → the color blue: 藍色(blue).

examples.chinese: 結婚以前，他覺得工作最重要，現在他覺得家人最重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn yǐqián, tā juéde gōngzuò zuì zhòngyào, xiànzài tā juéde jiārén zuì zhòngyào.
examples.english: Before getting married, he felt work was most important; now he feels family is most important.

examples.chinese: 你知道他要結婚的消息了嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā yào jiéhūn de xiāoxi le ma?
examples.english: Did you know the news that he is getting married?

examples.chinese: 結婚的時候，先生送了她一棟房子，讓她開心極了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn de shíhou, xiānsheng sòng le tā yī dòng fángzi, ràng tā kāixīn jí le.
examples.english: When they got married, her husband gave her a house, which made her extremely happy.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"為了給孩子幸福的生活，很多父母一輩子都努力地工作。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"王先生這輩子沒結婚，他希望下輩子會有機會。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wèile gěi háizi xìngfú de shēnghuó, hěn duō fùmǔ yíbèizi dōu nǔlì de gōngzuò. Wáng xiānsheng zhè bèizi méi jiéhūn, tā xīwàng xià bèizi huì yǒu jīhuì.
examples.english: In order to give their children a happy life, many parents work hard their whole life. Mr. Wang hasn't married in this lifetime; he hopes he will have a chance in the next life.

examples.chinese: 這家大飯店的禮堂很漂亮，很多人都在這裡結婚、請客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā dà fàndiàn de lǐtáng hěn piàoliang, hěn duō rén dōu zài zhèlǐ jiéhūn, qǐngkè.
examples.english: The hall of this grand hotel is very beautiful; many people get married and hold banquets here.

examples.chinese: 聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?
examples.english: I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 王小姐用網路交友的方式，找到了理想的結婚對象。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě yòng wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì, zhǎodàole lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng.
examples.english: Miss Wang used the method of making friends online and found her ideal marriage partner.

examples.chinese: 他透過網路認識了一位網友，直到結婚前，他們才見過對方三次。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò wǎnglù rènshi le yī wèi wǎngyǒu, zhídào jiéhūn qián, tāmen cái jiàn guò duìfāng sān cì.
examples.english: He met an online friend through the Internet, and they had only seen each other three times before they got married.

examples.chinese: 某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。
examples.pinyin: Mǒu nián mǒu yuè de mǒu yī tiān, nǐ huì zhǎodào xīnzhōng zuì lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng, xiànzài bié jí.
examples.english: On a certain day of a certain month in a certain year, you will find the most ideal marriage partner in your heart; don't rush now.

examples.chinese: 何先生早就習慣了單身生活，一點都不想結婚。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng zǎo jiù xíguàn le dānshēn shēnghuó, yīdiǎn dōu bù xiǎng jiéhūn.
examples.english: Mr. He has long been accustomed to single life and doesn't want to get married at all.

examples.chinese: 小章已經結婚了，還常常跟其他女生約會，真是太花心了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng yǐjīng jiéhūn le, hái chángcháng gēn qítā nǚshēng yuēhuì, zhēn shì tài huāxīn le.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is already married, yet he often dates other girls; he is really too womanizing.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me.

examples.chinese: 小張已經四十歲了，父母盼望他快點找到結婚對象，他卻一點也不著急。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎozhāng yǐjīng sìshí suì le, fùmǔ pànwàng tā kuài diǎn zhǎodào jiéhūn duìxiàng, tā què yīdiǎn yě bù zháojí.
examples.english: Xiaozhang is already forty years old; his parents yearn for him to quickly find a marriage partner, but he is not anxious at all.

examples.chinese: 想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin: 1. Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí. 2. Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le. 3. Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english: 1. Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling. 2. Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires. 3. Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
examples.english: Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.

examples.chinese: 我姑姑跟姑丈結婚已經有二十年了，感情一直很好。
我好友都已結婚了，什麼時候才換我辦喜事，請大家喝喜酒？
聽說那位新郎在事業上很有成就，況且優點也不少，跟他結婚的女人應該很幸福。
我同事下個月總算要和交往十年的女朋友結婚了，真是不容易啊！。
老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
這對情侶找了幾位朋友商量，一起安排結婚典禮。
他與妻子雖然已結婚多年，感情仍維持得很好，真令人羨慕。
我家有一個小花園，媽媽有空就在那裡種花、剪草。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yí ge xiǎo huāyuán, māma yǒu kòng jiù zài nàlǐ zhòng huā, jiǎn cǎo.
examples.english: My home has a small garden; when my mother has free time, she plants flowers and trims the grass there.

examples.chinese: 有的房子前院、後院都有花園，住起來一定很舒服。
從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
我弟弟喜歡打棒球，我想送他一個棒球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xǐhuān dǎ bàngqiú, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge bàngqiú.
examples.english: My younger brother likes playing baseball, I’d like to give him a baseball as a gift.

items.wordHook: a 木(tree) branch 奉(offer) to a hiker's hand → 棒(stick).

examples.chinese: 這家咖啡館有免費的無線網路，我可以邊喝咖啡邊上網。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, wǒ kěyǐ biān hē kāfēi biān shàngwǎng.
examples.english: This café has free Wi-Fi; I can drink coffee while surfing the internet.

examples.chinese: 有了無線網路，就可以隨時隨地上網查資料、看影片，或是玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le wúxiàn wǎnglù, jiù kěyǐ suíshísuídì shàngwǎng chá zīliào, kàn yǐngpiàn, huòshì wán yóuxì.
examples.english: With wireless internet, you can go online anytime, anywhere to look up information, watch videos, or play games.

examples.chinese: 我的行李很重，除了大衣、外套，還裝了一些書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xíngli hěn zhòng, chúle dàyī, wàitào, hái zhuāng le yīxiē shū.
examples.english: My luggage is very heavy; besides a coat and a jacket, I also packed some books.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"大衣、毛衣、外套等服裝，這家店都賣。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"學中文，聽、說、讀、寫等四個部分，都需要多練習。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Dàyī, máoyī, wàitào děng fúzhuāng, zhè jiā diàn dōu mài. Xué Zhōngwén, tīng, shuō, dú, xiě děng sì gè bùfèn, dōu xūyào duō liànxí.
examples.english: This store sells clothing such as coats, sweaters, and jackets. In learning Chinese, the four parts—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—all require a lot of practice.

examples.chinese: 這件大衣的設計很簡單，可是穿起來很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn dàyī de shèjì hěn jiǎndān, kěshì chuān qǐlái hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The design of this coat is very simple, but it looks good when you put it on.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english: When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 六點了，我要洗米煮飯了。
examples.pinyin: Liù diǎn le, wǒ yào xǐ mǐ zhǔ fàn le.
examples.english: It's six o'clock; I need to wash the rice and cook it.

examples.chinese: 我會煮飯、煮水餃，還會炒米粉呢！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo, hái huì chǎo mǐfěn ne!
examples.english: I can cook rice, boil dumplings, and even stir-fry rice noodles!

examples.chinese: 我會煮飯、煮水餃，還會炒米粉呢！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo, hái huì chǎo mǐfěn ne!
examples.english: I can cook rice, boil dumplings, and even stir-fry rice noodles!

examples.chinese: 吉米來臺灣五年了，喜歡這裡的食物和人，不過還不能適應夏天的天氣。
examples.pinyin: Jímǐ lái Táiwān wǔ nián le, xǐhuān zhèlǐ de shíwù hé rén, bùguò hái bù néng shìyìng xiàtiān de tiānqì.
examples.english: Jimmy has been in Taiwan for five years and likes the food and people here, but he still can't adapt to the summer weather.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

examples.chinese: 中國南北方的飲食習慣有一些差異，南方人多吃米飯，北方人多吃餃子、饅頭等麵食。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó nánběifāng de yǐnshí xíguàn yǒu yīxiē chāyì, nánfāng rén duō chī mǐfàn, běifāng rén duō chī jiǎozi, mántou děng miànshí.
examples.english: There are some differences in eating habits between northern and southern China: southerners eat more cooked rice, while northerners eat more dumplings, steamed buns, and other wheat-based foods.

examples.chinese: 奶奶養了幾隻雞，每天早上習慣抓兩把玉米餵牠們。

items.wordHook: Two 丷(horns) of grain hang on a 木(tree) like rice on a stalk → 米(rice).

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在古代的中國，只有有錢、有背景的人才可以去學校讀書。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài de Zhōngguó, zhǐyǒu yǒu qián, yǒu bèijǐng de rén cái kěyǐ qù xuéxiào dúshū.
examples.english: In ancient China, only people with money and background could go to school to study.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 在古代，國王所說的話是絕對的，也是最高的命令。
那家博物館平日展覽的物品很多，中多半與古代科技有關。
世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
古代人非常尊敬大自然，認為土地、山與河都有神。
他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

items.wordHook: A single tiny 禾(grain) drops in just a 少(few) fleeting moments of time → 秒(second).

examples.chinese: 這部愛情電影是根據真實故事拍出來的，看過的人都很有感覺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù àiqíng diànyǐng shì gēnjù zhēnshí gùshì pāi chūlái de, kànguò de rén dōu hěn yǒu gǎnjué.
examples.english: This romance movie was made according to a true story; everyone who has seen it feels deeply moved.

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
根據規定，每位旅客只能攜帶一件七公斤以下的行李上飛機。
根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
根據手機公司的分析，明年大尺寸手機的市場需求會提高五倍以上。
不要僅根據表面來判斷一個人或一件事，得花時間深入瞭解。
根據美國某項研究資料，青少年因腦震盪而被送到醫院的意外中，超過一半是因為激烈運動引起的。
根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。
根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
根據華人民間的說法，過年時如果收到紅包，整年就會有好運氣。
根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
根據醫院規定，進入病房後禁止大聲說話。
從小我父母就去世了，一直是我大哥、大嫂在照顧我的。
他大哥跟大嫂是同年同月同日生的，真是太巧了。
我大哥去年娶了英國太太，我們都好喜歡這位美麗的大嫂。
我很怕熱，不過天氣太冷的時候，也不得不開暖氣。
今天氣溫只有零下(below zero)三度，我家沒暖氣，不管穿多厚的衣服，全身還是冰冰的。
這班學生多數都會說法國話，其中有半數是從歐洲來的。
對大多數人來說，沒有用的垃圾是廢物，有用的垃圾是資源。
大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在中國，大多數南方人吃飯，北方人吃麵和水餃。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, dàduōshù nánfāng rén chī fàn, běifāng rén chī miàn hé shuǐjiǎo.
examples.english: In China, most southerners eat rice, while northerners eat noodles and dumplings.

examples.chinese: 在中國，大多數南方人吃飯，北方人吃麵和水餃。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, dàduōshù nánfāng rén chī fàn, běifāng rén chī miàn hé shuǐjiǎo.
examples.english: In China, most southerners eat rice, while northerners eat noodles and dumplings.

examples.chinese: 在春節的前一天，大多數的華人都會回到父母家一起慶祝。
examples.pinyin: Zài Chūnjié de qián yī tiān, dàduōshù de Huárén dōu huì huí dào fùmǔ jiā yīqǐ qìngzhù.
examples.english: On the day before the Spring Festival, most Chinese people return to their parents' home to celebrate together.

examples.chinese: 不管大人還是小孩，大多數的人都喜歡流行的東西。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn dàrén háishì xiǎohái, dàduōshù de rén dōu xǐhuān liúxíng de dōngxi.
examples.english: No matter adults or children, most people like trendy things.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，到舞廳跳舞的多數是年輕人。
為了發展個人事業而放下學業，多數人是很難做到的。
大多數的模特兒都是腿長腰細的，穿什麼服裝都好看。
大多數投資專家都不敢保證在房屋市場一定能賺錢。
我國四季都有美麗的風景：春季時平原有花海、夏季時海灘有日出、秋季時山區有紅樹、冬季時高山有白雪，都十分迷人。
每個人都得經驗老病死，這些都是自然發生，避免不了的。
學校每學期都帶學生到郊外旅行，體驗大自然的美好。
大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
工廠排水系統得設計好，以免汙染自然環境。
人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān yǒngyǒu fēngfù de sēnlín zīyuán hé dútè de zìrán fēngjǐng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn bùshǎo yóukè qù nàlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: Alishan owns rich forest resources and unique natural scenery, attracting many tourists to travel there every year.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 他去當環保志工是為了保護自然環境，也是為了培養耐心。
用人類的角度去看大自然， 就看不出大自然的本來價值。
接觸陌生的事情及環境時，往往令人有點兒不安，這樣的感覺是很自然的。
古代人非常尊敬大自然，認為土地、山與河都有神。
今天的自然科學課程所介紹的主題是月球的構造。

items.wordHook: Allowing things to unfold from their 自(self) true essence 然(certainly) without interference: 自然 means natural.

examples.chinese: 我大哥去年娶了英國太太，我們都好喜歡這位美麗的大嫂。
他上班時常戴著一副黑色眼鏡，那副樣子總是讓我忘不了。
錢小姐戴的那副耳環就像星光一樣美麗，聽說那是祖母留給她的回憶。
為了找件漂亮又划算的衣服，她可是能逛百貨公司好幾圈的。

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) takes a 分(fraction) of the stack → one 份(copy).
a 口(mouth) takes in the 欶(suck) of warm water → one loud 嗽(gargle).
Combining 推(push) and 銷(fuse): 推銷 means sell.
Combining 樹(tree) and 木(wood): 樹木 means tree.
a 䏍(secret flesh) grips a 匕(spoon) → showing what a strong body 能(can) do.
Under a 宀(roof), an 𠀎(offering) of 八(eight) 貝(sea shells) draws rivals to 賽(compete).
With urgent 辶(movement) up the grassy 阜(mound), guards race to 追(pursue) the fugitive.
a 者(zhě) call stands in every 阝(place) → 都(all) answer.
黃(yellow) + 色(color) → the color yellow: 黃色(yellow).
